meaning: A tiny picture, like a face or an animal, that you put in a message to show a feeling.
clues: People use it in messages to show how they feel.
It's a tiny picture that sits right in a line of words, like a letter. It isn't built from keyboard marks or sent as its own image.
Its name comes from two Japanese words that mean picture and character.
Faces, animals, food, and weather are common kinds.
It has five letters and starts with E.
assumes: An emoticon is built from keyboard marks
A GIF is sent as its own image or clip
A meme is a widely shared online joke or idea

decoys.meaning: A face made from keyboard marks, like a colon and a parenthesis, to show a feeling in a message.
An image or video saved in a certain kind of file. People can add one to a message.
A funny picture or video that people pass around online.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We typed a colon and a parenthesis to make a little face. People have long wanted to add feeling to typed words.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it in a text to someone you trust. Tap the emoji button or the globe on your keyboard, pick one, and send it.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If you don't see that button, ask someone you trust to add the emoji keyboard in your keyboard settings.

sources.name: Apple Support, Use emoji on your iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch

blank.sentence: She tapped the face button on her keyboard, and a tiny smiling ___ went into her message.

why: A tiny picture can show a feeling that plain typed words may miss.
short: Tiny picture that shows a feeling

situations.text: You want to add a tiny face to your text. Can you tap the emoji button or the globe on your keyboard?
situations.why: Tap that button, pick one, and send it.
